rows.title: Study-permit extension filing emphasis
predicted_changes: Added/emphasized: Extension must be submitted on Enter Hungary at least 30 days before expiry.
Added/emphasized: Upload the required documents online, then give biometrics at the regional client service within 15 days.
Removed/softened: Students were sometimes told in informal guides to inquire at a counter first.
Removed/softened: Document lists varied by office handouts.
expected_changes: Enter Hungary online filing is mandatory in the current know-how
Biometrics within 15 days after submission is stated
